sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导者，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在 11 月 18 日通过 nytimes.com 网站，

sentences.en: November 18th.
sentences.zh: 对部分采访进行免费直播，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: In testimony before Congress, the chief executive of Boeing said, quote,
sentences.zh: 在国会作证时，波音公司首席执行官表示，引用他的话：

sentences.en: If we knew everything back then that we know now, we would have made a different decision.
sentences.zh: “如果我们当时就知道现在所知道的一切，我们一定会做出不同的决定。”

sentences.en: So what did Boeing executives know?
sentences.zh: 那么，波音高管当时到底知道什么？

sentences.en: And when did they know it?
sentences.zh: 他们又是何时知道的？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 31St.
sentences.zh: 今天是 10 月 31 日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Natalie, for the past six months, we have been talking to you about what went wrong with Boeing's
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，过去六个月里，我们一直在和你讨论波音

sentences.en: 737 MAX, this jet that crashed twice, basically back-to-back over the past year, and both times killed everybody on board.
sentences.zh: 737 MAX 飞机出了什么问题，这架飞机在过去一年里几乎接连发生了两次坠机事故，两次都导致机上所有人遇难。

sentences.en: Remind us what you have uncovered about those crashes up until now.
sentences.zh: 请提醒我们，到目前为止你对这些坠机事故有哪些发现。

sentences.en: What went wrong?
sentences.zh: 到底出了什么问题？

sentences.en: So the first 737 MAX crashes in October, it's not really clear what's going on.
sentences.zh: 第一起 737 MAX 坠机事故发生在 10 月，当时情况并不明朗。

sentences.en: It seems like it's a new automated system on the plane.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是飞机上的一套新自动化系统出了问题。

sentences.en: Less than five months later, another plane crashes in
sentences.zh: 不到五个月后，另一架飞机在

sentences.en: Ethiopia.
sentences.zh: 埃塞俄比亚坠毁。

sentences.en: And at that point, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，美国

sentences.en: and regulators around the world ground the plane.
sentences.zh: 以及世界各地的监管机构下令停飞了该机型。

sentences.en: That's when we really started digging into what went wrong here.
sentences.zh: 也就是从那时起，我们开始深入挖掘到底哪里出了问题。

sentences.en: Natalie Kicheroff is a business reporter at The Times.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉·基切罗夫是《时报》的一名商业记者。

sentences.en: And one of the central questions we've been trying to get at is, how was this plane designed and how was it certified?
sentences.zh: 我们一直试图弄清楚的核心问题之一是：这架飞机是如何设计并获得认证的？

sentences.en: What we found out was that what contributed to both accidents was this
sentences.zh: 我们发现，导致这两起事故的原因是这个

sentences.en: MCAS system that was supposed to help pilots.
sentences.zh: MCAS 系统，它本应是用来辅助飞行员的。

sentences.en: But what it actually did was constantly push the nose of the plane down.
sentences.zh: 但它实际的作用却是不断地将机头向下压。

sentences.en: So they had to struggle with it in both accidents.
sentences.zh: 所以在两起事故中，飞行员都不得不与它进行抗争。

sentences.en: And the system pushed both planes into fatal nosedives.
sentences.zh: 该系统最终导致两架飞机都陷入了致命的俯冲。

sentences.en: And so there were design weaknesses there that were built into this system from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 因此，该系统从一开始就存在设计缺陷。

sentences.en: And on the regulator side, we learned that the Federal Aviation
sentences.zh: 而在监管方面，我们了解到联邦航空

sentences.en: Administration basically handed Boeing the responsibility for determining the safety of much of this aircraft.
sentences.zh: 管理局基本上将确定这架飞机大部分安全性的责任交给了波音公司。

sentences.en: Boeing was regulating itself to a certain degree.
sentences.zh: 波音在一定程度上是在自我监管。

sentences.en: And Boeing never really fully explains this system, MCAS, to the regulators.
sentences.zh: 而且波音从未真正向监管机构完整解释过这个 MCAS 系统。

sentences.en: And this is the system that contributes to both of the crashes.
sentences.zh: 而这正是导致两起坠机事故的系统。

sentences.en: But one of the central questions that remained was, what did Boeing know?
sentences.zh: 但遗留的核心问题之一是：波音到底知道什么？

sentences.en: What did the executives at the highest levels of the company know about potential problems with this plane, about potential flaws in this system?
sentences.zh: 公司最高层的管理人员对这架飞机的潜在问题、对该系统的潜在缺陷了解多少？

sentences.en: And when did they know it?
sentences.zh: 他们又是何时知道的？

sentences.en: And that's why the CEO of Boeing,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么波音首席执行官

sentences.en: Dennis Mullenberg, was hauled up to the Hill to testify in front of Congress this week for the first time since both crashes.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·米伦伯格本周被传唤到国会山作证，这是自两起坠机事故发生以来的首次。

sentences.en: Because lawmakers had the same questions that we did.
sentences.zh: 因为立法者们有着和我们一样的问题。

sentences.en: This hearing will come to order.
sentences.zh: 现在听证会开始。

sentences.en: Thank you all for being here today.
sentences.zh: 感谢大家今天到场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And you were there.
sentences.zh: 你当时也在现场。

sentences.en: So set the scene for us of what this was like inside the Capitol.
sentences.zh: 那么请为我们还原一下国会大厦内的情况。

sentences.en: So the hearings start on Tuesday in the Senate, and the room is palpably tense.
sentences.zh: 听证会于周二在参议院开始，房间里的气氛明显非常紧张。

sentences.en: There is a row of family members of the victims of the crashes that are holding signs showing the faces of their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 一排遇难者家属坐在那里，举着印有亲人照片的牌子。

sentences.en: And then Dennis Mullenberg files in, and he takes his seat, and he begins delivering his opening statement.
sentences.zh: 随后丹尼斯·米伦伯格走进来，入座并开始宣读他的开场陈述。

sentences.en: Chairman Wicker, ranking member Cantwell, committee members, thank you for the opportunity to join you today.
sentences.zh: 威克主席、威克尔资深成员坎特韦尔、各位委员会成员，感谢你们今天给我这个机会。

sentences.en: And we share your commitment to aviation safety.
sentences.zh: 我们与你们一样，致力于航空安全。

sentences.en: He's not someone who's known as a very comfortable public speaker.
sentences.zh: 他并不是一个以擅长公开演讲而著称的人。

sentences.en: He sometimes has a wooden affect.
sentences.zh: 他有时表现得有些木讷。

sentences.en: Before we start today, I'd like to speak directly to the families of the victims who are here with us.
sentences.zh: 在今天开始之前，我想直接对在场的遇难者家属说几句话。

sentences.en: But he begins his opening statement by immediately apologizing to the families.
sentences.zh: 但他开场的第一件事就是立即向家属们道歉。

sentences.en: We are sorry, deeply and truly sorry.
sentences.zh: 我们感到抱歉，深切且真诚地感到抱歉。

sentences.en: As a husband and father myself, I'm heartbroken by your losses.
sentences.zh: 作为一名丈夫和父亲，我对你们失去亲人感到心碎。

sentences.en: I think about you and your loved ones every day, and I know our entire Boeing team does as well.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在想念你们和你们的亲人，我知道我们整个波音团队也是如此。

sentences.en: He says that the company knows that it made mistakes, and he vows to make improvements.
sentences.zh: 他说公司知道自己犯了错误，并誓言要做出改进。

sentences.en: We can and must do better.
sentences.zh: 我们能够而且必须做得更好。

sentences.en: This is someone whose entire career, basically, has been devoted to the Boeing company.
sentences.zh: 这是一个几乎将整个职业生涯都奉献给波音公司的人。

sentences.en: I started at Boeing as a summer intern in Seattle.
sentences.zh: 我最初是以暑期实习生的身份在西雅图加入波音的。

sentences.en: I was a junior at Iowa State University, studying engineering, having grown up on a family farm in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 当时我是爱荷华州立大学的大三学生，主修工程学，在爱荷华州的家庭农场长大。

sentences.en: I was awestruck to work at the company that brought the jet age to the world and helped land a person on the moon.
sentences.zh: 能在这家将喷气机时代带给世界并帮助人类登上月球的公司工作，我感到敬畏。

sentences.en: And he's saying, look, we share your commitment to safety.
sentences.zh: 他想表达的是，看，我们和你们一样致力于安全。

sentences.en: And that's what he's there to really persuade them of.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他真正想说服他们相信的事情。

sentences.en: And he says, you know, that he is looking forward to their questions,
sentences.zh: 他说，他期待着回答他们的问题，

sentences.en: questions that turn out to be a pummeling from senators.
sentences.zh: 但这些问题最终变成了参议员们的一顿猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, the senators from the get-go are really laying into Mr. Mullenberg.
sentences.zh: 嗯，参议员们从一开始就对米伦伯格先生进行了严厉的质询。

sentences.en: I've got to tell you, and I think I told you guys this in office some time ago,
sentences.zh: 我必须告诉你，我想我前段时间在办公室里也跟你们说过，

sentences.en: I would walk before I was to get on a 737 MAX.
sentences.zh: 如果让我坐 737 MAX，我宁愿走路。

sentences.en: I would walk.
sentences.zh: 我宁愿走路。

sentences.en: There's no way.
sentences.zh: 绝不可能。

sentences.en: And the one who really goes the hardest is Senator Ted Cruz.
sentences.zh: 而其中最强硬的要数参议员泰德·克鲁兹。

sentences.en: Mr. Mullenberg, I have to say the testimony here today has been quite dismayed.
sentences.zh: 米伦伯格先生，我不得不说，今天这里的证词令人非常失望。

sentences.en: Senator Cruz starts in on a really intense line of questioning about this set of instant messages
sentences.zh: 克鲁兹参议员开始了一连串非常激烈的质询，内容涉及 2016 年 11 月的一组即时通讯记录，

sentences.en: from November 2016, long before the crashes, that Congress just recently got its hands on.
sentences.zh: 那是在坠机事故发生很久之前，国会最近才拿到这些记录。

sentences.en: This was a text exchange between Mark Fortner, who was then Boeing's chief technical pilot for the MAX, and Mr. Gustafson, Boeing's 737 chief technical pilot.
sentences.zh: 这是一段马克·福特纳（时任波音 MAX 首席技术飞行员）与古斯塔夫森（波音 737 首席技术飞行员）之间的短信交流。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: I believe that's the case, Senator.
sentences.zh: 我相信情况确实如此，参议员。

sentences.en: So this exchange is stunning.
sentences.zh: 所以这段交流令人震惊。

sentences.en: In the messages, one of the pilots, a guy named Mark Fortner, is talking about how MCAS, this system, is causing him trouble in the simulator.
sentences.zh: 在这些信息中，其中一名飞行员，一个叫马克·福特纳的人，谈到了 MCAS 这个系统如何在模拟器中给他制造麻烦。

sentences.en: Mr. Fortner, oh, shocker alert.
sentences.zh: 福特纳先生，哦，惊人的警报。

sentences.en: MCAS is now active down to M2.
sentences.zh: MCAS 现在在 M2 以下处于激活状态。

sentences.en: It's running rampant in the sim on me.
sentences.zh: 它在模拟器里对我横冲直撞。

sentences.en: He says, it's running rampant in the flight simulator.
sentences.zh: 他说，它在飞行模拟器里横冲直撞。

sentences.en: That's this giant machine that's used for testing.
sentences.zh: 那就是那个用于测试的巨型机器。

sentences.en: And then he says,
sentences.zh: 然后他说，

sentences.en: Mr. Fortner, so basically I lied to the regulators unknowingly.
sentences.zh: 福特纳先生，所以基本上我在不知情的情况下对监管机构撒了谎。

sentences.en: So I basically lied to regulators unknowingly.
sentences.zh: 所以我基本上在不知情的情况下对监管机构撒了谎。

sentences.en: And what does he mean by that?
sentences.zh: 他这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, the Times revealed in an investigation earlier this year that Fortner, months before
sentences.zh: 嗯，《时报》今年早些时候的一项调查显示，福特纳在这些信息发出几个月前，

sentences.en: these messages, had asked the FAA to take MCAS, to take this system out of the pilot's manual.
sentences.zh: 曾要求美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）将 MCAS 从飞行员手册中删除。

sentences.en: And at the time, he described it as a system that would almost never activate in a normal flight and that wasn't all that significant.
sentences.zh: 当时，他将其描述为一个在正常飞行中几乎永远不会激活、且并不那么重要的系统。

sentences.en: He played down the risks.
sentences.zh: 他淡化了风险。

sentences.en: It seems like he's realizing that this system, MCAS, is more problematic than he thought and that he had told the FAA.
sentences.zh: 看起来他意识到这个 MCAS 系统比他想象的以及他告诉 FAA 的情况要麻烦得多。

sentences.en: That is one possibility.
sentences.zh: 这是一种可能性。

sentences.en: And it's certainly what many senators on Tuesday seemed to think was happening.
sentences.zh: 而且这无疑是周二许多参议员认为正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And how does Muhlenberg respond to this line of questioning, especially from Senator
sentences.zh: 那么米伦伯格是如何回应这一连串质询的，尤其是来自参议员

sentences.en: Cruz, who's coming so hard at him about it?
sentences.zh: 克鲁兹的猛烈抨击？

sentences.en: Well, Muhlenberg says that he became aware of these messages between the pilots before the second crash.
sentences.zh: 嗯，米伦伯格说他在第二次坠机前就知道了飞行员之间的这些信息。

sentences.en: But he says he did not dig into the details until very recently.
sentences.zh: 但他表示直到最近才深入了解细节。

sentences.en: And that's the point on which Senator Cruz really hammers him.
sentences.zh: 而这正是克鲁兹参议员对他穷追猛打的地方。

sentences.en: He says, you're the CEO.
sentences.zh: 他说，你是首席执行官。

sentences.en: The buck stops with you.
sentences.zh: 责任由你承担。

sentences.en: Did you read this document?
sentences.zh: 你读过这份文件吗？

sentences.en: And how did your team not put it in front of you, run in with their hair on fire saying we got a real problem here?
sentences.zh: 你的团队怎么没有把它放在你面前，怎么没有火烧眉毛地跑来告诉你我们遇到了大麻烦？

sentences.en: How did you not in February set out a nine alarm fire to say we need to figure out exactly what happened, not after all the
sentences.zh: 为什么你在二月份没有拉响九级警报，说我们需要查清楚到底发生了什么，不是在所有听证会之后，不是在压力之下，而是因为 346 人已经丧生，我们不想再有任何人死亡？

sentences.en: hearings, not after the pressure, but because 346 people have died and we don't want another person to die?
sentences.zh: 他基本上是在对首席执行官说，你应该关注这件事。

sentences.en: He's basically saying to the CEO, you should have been on this.
sentences.zh: 在第二次坠机发生之前，你就应该想知道这些信息里写了什么。

sentences.en: You should have wanted to know what was in those messages before the second crash happened.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，参议员们一直在问他这个问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, senators were asking him this question.
sentences.zh: 事实上，直到又发生了一场悲剧，飞机才真正停飞，这样你们才能有一个有效的修复方案。

sentences.en: The fact that it took another tragedy to actually ground the airplane so you could actually have a fix that worked.
sentences.zh: 为什么你们不早点采取行动？

sentences.en: Why didn't you act sooner?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有反应？

sentences.en: Why didn't we react?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有早点停飞那架飞机，从而避免另一场悲剧发生？

sentences.en: Why didn't we ground that aircraft a lot sooner so another tragedy wouldn't happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们没有更早地停飞飞机？

sentences.en: Why didn't we ground the plane earlier?
sentences.zh: 在第二次坠机之前。

sentences.en: Before the second crash.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 我们本可以避免第二场悲剧。

sentences.en: We could have avoided a second tragedy.
sentences.zh: 而且……

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 参议员，我们已经反复问过这个问题，而且……

sentences.en: Senator, we have asked that question over and over and...
sentences.zh: 他说如果能回到过去重来一次……

sentences.en: He said if we could go back and do it over...
sentences.zh: 如果我们能回到过去，我们一定会做出不同的决定。

sentences.en: If we could go back, we would have made a different decision.
sentences.zh: 我们会在第一次坠机后就停飞飞机。

sentences.en: We would ground the plane after the first crash.
sentences.zh: 如果我们当时掌握的信息和现在一样，我们就会采取不同的行动。

sentences.en: If we had the information then that we have now, we would have acted differently.
sentences.zh: 但立法者们有不同的看法。

sentences.en: But the lawmakers have a different view.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们中的许多人都在说，你们当时确实掌握了一些信息。

sentences.en: I mean, many of them are saying you did have some of this information.
sentences.zh: 他们提出的问题是，既然这些信息已经摆在你们的桌面上，为什么你们不早点采取行动？

sentences.en: And the question they're asking is, why didn't you act sooner, given what was already on your desk?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于波音知道什么、何时知道的核心问题，至少部分答案开始变得清晰起来，

sentences.en: So the central question about what Boeing knew, when it knew it, at least part of the answer
sentences.zh: 根据这些参议员的说法，那就是首席执行官在第二次坠机前就知道了一些事情。

sentences.en: is starting to become a little bit clearer, according to these senators, which is that the CEO knew something before the second crash.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，这些信息本应成为采取行动的基础，从而可能避免第二次坠机。

sentences.en: And they're saying that something should have been the basis for action that could have prevented the second crash.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 接下来这些听证会会发生什么？

sentences.en: What happens next in these hearings?
sentences.zh: 他们将如何继续追究波音内部到底知道什么这个问题？

sentences.en: How do they keep pursuing this question of what was known inside Boeing?
sentences.zh: 交通基础设施委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: Committee on Transportation Infrastructure will come to order.
sentences.zh: 交通基础设施委员会现在开会。

sentences.en: Well, they pursue it by continuing to dig into documents.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们通过不断挖掘文件来追查此事。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, these hearings move to the
sentences.zh: 周三，这些听证会将移至

sentences.en: House.
sentences.zh: 众议院。

sentences.en: And the chairman of the Transportation Committee, Peter DeFazio, brings new documents.
sentences.zh: 交通委员会主席彼得·德法齐奥带来了新的文件。

sentences.en: I put up another document.
sentences.zh: 我展示了另一份文件。

sentences.en: It's right in front of you there.
sentences.zh: 就在你面前。
日期是2015年12月17日。

sentences.en: I don't know if you're aware of this, but this was raised by one of your engineers.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是否了解这一点，但这是你们的一位工程师提出的。

sentences.en: He brings one document that shows that in 2015, two years before the MAX was cleared to fly, a Boeing
sentences.zh: 他带来了一份文件，显示在2015年，即MAX获准飞行前两年，一名波音

sentences.en: employee raised concerns about the fact that the system could trigger based on just one sensor.
sentences.zh: 员工就该系统可能仅基于一个传感器触发的事实提出了担忧。

sentences.en: Are we vulnerable to a single AOA sensor failure with the MCAS implementation, or is there some checking that occurs?
sentences.zh: 在MCAS的实施中，我们是否容易受到单个AOA传感器故障的影响，还是说会有某种检查机制？

sentences.en: And the employee basically said, wait a minute, doesn't that make this system vulnerable to a single point of failure?
sentences.zh: 那位员工基本上是说，等一下，这难道不会使该系统容易受到单点故障的影响吗？

sentences.en: The concern is, if one sensor is responsible for all this, then if that sensor fails, the whole system is in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 令人担忧的是，如果一个传感器负责所有这些，那么一旦该传感器失效，整个系统就岌岌可危了。

sentences.en: And that is precisely what happened in both of the crashes.
sentences.zh: 而这正是两次坠机事故中发生的情况。

sentences.en: So that's a very specific warning, and a warning that came, according to DeFazio, years before the
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常具体的警告，而且根据德法齐奥的说法，这个警告在

sentences.en: plane was even on the market, which feels like a very significant and potentially damning revelation.
sentences.zh: 飞机上市前几年就出现了，这感觉是一个非常重大且可能具有毁灭性的揭露。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then we have information provided to the committee by Boeing, which will now be the second slide.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们有波音公司提供给委员会的信息，这将是第二张幻灯片。

sentences.en: We also saw a document that showed that Boeing employees determined in June of 2018, this is after
sentences.zh: 我们还看到一份文件显示，波音员工在2018年6月确定——这是在

sentences.en: the plane is flying, but months before the first crash, that if pilots took more than 10 seconds to intervene after an MCAS malfunction, the result could be catastrophic.
sentences.zh: 飞机投入飞行之后，但在第一次坠机前几个月——如果飞行员在MCAS故障后超过10秒才进行干预，结果可能是灾难性的。

sentences.en: And it says a slow reaction time scenario, 10 seconds, found the failure to be catastrophic.
sentences.zh: 上面写着一个反应缓慢的情景，10秒，发现故障是灾难性的。

sentences.en: Meaning the plane would go down.
sentences.zh: 意思是飞机将会坠毁。

sentences.en: That a 10-second delay, which doesn't seem like a lot of time to me.
sentences.zh: 10秒的延迟，在我看来这似乎不是很多时间。

sentences.en: Just 10 seconds, there was basically no margin for error, and the plane could crash.
sentences.zh: 仅仅10秒，基本上没有容错空间，飞机就可能坠毁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, keep in mind, 10 seconds for a pilot is longer than it seeMs. But what we saw in these accidents is that pilots weren't immediately responding to this system.
sentences.zh: 记住，对飞行员来说，10秒比看起来要长。但我们在这些事故中看到的是，飞行员并没有立即对该系统做出反应。

sentences.en: There were so many warnings in the cockpit as this system was going off, as it was malfunctioning, that they became overwhelmed, it seemed.
sentences.zh: 当该系统启动并发生故障时，驾驶舱内有太多的警告，他们似乎不知所措。

sentences.en: And that's part of why what you saw was they're fighting against this nose-down movement until the planes both went into fatal nosedives.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么你看到他们一直在与这种机头下压的动作抗争，直到两架飞机都进入了致命的俯冲。

sentences.en: I'd like to read from an email that was sent to the general manager of the 737 program in June 2018.
sentences.zh: 我想读一封2018年6月发给737项目总经理的电子邮件。

sentences.en: And we also heard about an exchange between a Boeing employee and the general manager of the 737 program from June 2018.
sentences.zh: 我们还听到了2018年6月波音员工与737项目总经理之间的一次交流。

sentences.en: Again, this is months before the first crash, in which this employee says that I have some safety concerns that I need to share with you as the leader of the 737 program.
sentences.zh: 同样，这是在第一次坠机前几个月，这位员工说，作为737项目的领导者，我有一些安全方面的担忧需要与你分享。

sentences.en: My first concern, he states, is that our workforce is exhausted.
sentences.zh: 他陈述说，我的第一个担忧是我们的员工已经精疲力竭。

sentences.en: The workforce is exhausted on the 737 line.
sentences.zh: 737生产线的员工已经精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Employees are fatigued.
sentences.zh: 员工们感到疲劳。

sentences.en: Employees are fatigued from having to work at a very high pace for an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 员工们因为长期以极高的节奏工作而感到疲惫。

sentences.en: Fatigued employees make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 疲劳的员工会犯错。

sentences.en: Make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 会犯错。

sentences.en: And that schedule pressure combined with fatigue is creating a culture where employees are either deliberately or unconsciously circumventing established processes.
sentences.zh: 这种进度压力加上疲劳，正在创造一种文化，使员工要么故意，要么无意识地绕过既定流程。

sentences.en: This employee points to process breakdowns and says, look, all my internal warning bells are going off.
sentences.zh: 这位员工指出了流程崩溃，并说，看，我内心所有的警钟都在响。

sentences.en: And for the first time in my life, I am sorry to say that I am hesitant about putting my family on a Boeing airplane.
sentences.zh: 我遗憾地说，我这辈子第一次对让我的家人乘坐波音飞机感到犹豫。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So in the second day of hearings, as these documents are being presented or described, does it become clear whether Mullenberg or any of the senior executives at Boeing saw them
sentences.zh: 那么在听证会的第二天，随着这些文件被展示或描述，穆伦伯格或波音的任何高管是否清楚他们

sentences.en: when they were being generated and, of course, before the planes crashed?
sentences.zh: 在这些文件生成时，当然是在飞机坠毁前，是否看到了它们？

sentences.en: Well, we don't know in every case, but we know for sure that he received the warning about how
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们不能确定每一种情况，但我们确定他收到了关于

sentences.en: the 737 line workers were fatigued and potentially cutting corners because that email went directly to him.
sentences.zh: 737生产线工人如何疲惫并可能偷工减料的警告，因为那封邮件直接发给了他。

sentences.en: Congressman, I'm familiar with that last communication that you referenced, and we did have several follow-up sessions with him.
sentences.zh: 议员，我熟悉你提到的那最后一次沟通，我们确实与他进行了几次后续会议。

sentences.en: I told him I appreciated the fact that he brought up those issues and concerns.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我很感激他提出了这些问题和担忧。

sentences.en: And just one quick follow-up.
sentences.zh: 还有一个简短的后续问题。

sentences.en: Representative DeFazio asked Mr. Mullenberg, did you slow down production after you received this message?
sentences.zh: 德法齐奥众议员问穆伦伯格先生，你在收到这条信息后是否放慢了生产速度？

sentences.en: Did you reduce the rate of production at that point in time, given his concerns?
sentences.zh: 考虑到他的担忧，你在那个时候是否降低了生产率？

sentences.en: And Mullenberg said no.
sentences.zh: 穆伦伯格说没有。

sentences.en: Sir, we did not change the production rate.
sentences.zh: 先生，我们没有改变生产率。

sentences.en: Again, I think it's very important that when you change production rate in a line like ours, any change, up or down.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我认为非常重要的一点是，当你在我们这样的生产线上改变生产率时，任何改变，无论是增加还是减少。

sentences.en: Sir, I understand there's a whole supply chain.
sentences.zh: 先生，我明白这涉及整个供应链。

sentences.en: That's good.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

sentences.en: He said that the 737 factory kept churning out the planes at a rate of 52 a month.
sentences.zh: 他说737工厂继续以每月52架的速度生产飞机。

sentences.en: He said that it would have compromised safety to slow down production all of a sudden.
sentences.zh: 他说突然放慢生产速度会损害安全性。

sentences.en: It wasn't exactly clear what he meant by that.
sentences.zh: 他这话的意思并不完全清楚。

sentences.en: Natalie, what does it say about Boeing that all these puzzle pieces, all these various concerns
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，所有这些拼图碎片，所有这些在过去几天里被揭露出来的各种担忧，

sentences.en: that have been revealed over the past few days, that they never really came together for Boeing
sentences.zh: 它们从未真正为波音公司

sentences.en: and its top executives, at least in the telling of the CEO, to the point where the company felt it needed to act?
sentences.zh: 及其高管们拼凑在一起——至少在CEO的讲述中是这样——以至于公司觉得需要采取行动，这说明了什么？

sentences.en: Look, I think Boeing is wrestling with that question right now.
sentences.zh: 看，我认为波音公司现在正在努力解决这个问题。

sentences.en: On the one hand, you can see how inside the biggest aircraft maker in the world, there are sometimes emails that go to the CEO that might go unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你可以看到在世界上最大的飞机制造商内部，有时发给CEO的邮件可能会被忽视。

sentences.en: There are issues that people have that might not be taken seriously at the time because engineers always have disputes.
sentences.zh: 人们提出的一些问题在当时可能没有被认真对待，因为工程师之间总是有分歧。

sentences.en: You know, these things are always discussed.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些事情总是会被讨论。

sentences.en: You know, in retrospect, it can look much more significant.
sentences.zh: 你知道，事后看来，它看起来可能重要得多。

sentences.en: But at the time, it's just viewed as part of the process.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，它只是被视为流程的一部分。

sentences.en: On the other hand, this isn't just any other giant corporation.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，这不仅仅是任何其他巨型企业。

sentences.en: This is the biggest airplane manufacturer in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最大的飞机制造商。

sentences.en: The job is to produce safe airplanes.
sentences.zh: 工作职责是生产安全的飞机。

sentences.en: And when there are two catastrophic accidents that kill 346 people, it's obvious that lawmakers,
sentences.zh: 当发生两起导致346人死亡的灾难性事故时，很明显，立法者、

sentences.en: investigators, family members of the victims are going to comb through every warning, every potential concern that either was elevated to the highest levels or should have been.
sentences.zh: 调查人员、受害者家属将会梳理每一个警告，每一个可能被提升到最高层或本应被提升的潜在担忧。

sentences.en: And they're going to ask, why didn't you do more?
sentences.zh: 他们会问，为什么你们没有做得更多？

sentences.en: So after these two days of testimony, it's very clear that Boeing's CEO is sorry.
sentences.zh: 所以经过这两天的证词，很明显波音公司的CEO感到抱歉。

sentences.en: But it sounds like his overall message is that Boeing, knowing what it knew at the time,
sentences.zh: 但听起来他的总体信息是，波音公司在当时已知的情况下，

sentences.en: did what it could do.
sentences.zh: 已经尽其所能了。

sentences.en: But that the puzzle pieces did not come together in a way that would have really allowed Boeing to prevent these two plane crashes.
sentences.zh: 但这些拼图碎片并没有以一种真正能让波音公司防止这两起坠机事故的方式拼凑在一起。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that seems credible to these lawmakers.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这对这些立法者来说是否可信。

sentences.en: I have to say, I think overall, they believed that he was genuinely sorry, that he genuinely wanted to make improvements.
sentences.zh: 我必须说，我认为总的来说，他们相信他是真诚地感到抱歉，他真诚地想要做出改进。

sentences.en: But they seemed unconvinced that Boeing did all it could do.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎并不相信波音已经尽了全力。

sentences.en: And really, what they were pressing on was the question of accountability.
sentences.zh: 而且他们真正施压的是问责制的问题。

sentences.en: They want someone, maybe more than one person, to be held responsible for these accidents.
sentences.zh: 他们希望有人，也许不止一个人，为这些事故负责。

sentences.en: Let me ask you this, Mr. Muhlenberg.
sentences.zh: 让我问你这个，穆伦伯格先生。

sentences.en: You said you're accountable.
sentences.zh: 你说你负责。

sentences.en: At one point, Representative Stephen Cohen of Tennessee was basically yelling at Muhlenberg.
sentences.zh: 有一次，田纳西州的斯蒂芬·科恩众议员基本上是在对穆伦伯格大喊大叫。

sentences.en: What does accountability mean?
sentences.zh: 问责意味着什么？

sentences.en: Are you taking a cut in pay?
sentences.zh: 你是在减薪吗？

sentences.en: Are you working for free from now on until you can cure this problem?
sentences.zh: 从现在开始，直到你能解决这个问题，你是在免费工作吗？

sentences.en: These people's relatives are not coming back.
sentences.zh: 这些人的亲人回不来了。

sentences.en: They're gone.
sentences.zh: 他们走了。

sentences.en: Asking him, what does accountability mean?
sentences.zh: 问他，问责意味着什么？

sentences.en: Your salary's still on.
sentences.zh: 你的薪水还在照发。

sentences.en: Is anybody at Boeing taking a cut or working for free to try to rectify this problem?
sentences.zh: 波音公司有人在减薪或免费工作以试图纠正这个问题吗？

sentences.en: And what does Muhlenberg say?
sentences.zh: 穆伦伯格是怎么说的？

sentences.en: Congressman, it's not about the money for me.
sentences.zh: 议员，对我来说这不是钱的问题。

sentences.en: That's not why I came here.
sentences.zh: 我来这里不是为了这个。

sentences.en: Are you giving up any money?
sentences.zh: 你放弃任何钱了吗？

sentences.en: Congressman, my board will conduct a comprehensive review.
sentences.zh: 议员，我的董事会将进行全面审查。

sentences.en: So you're saying you're not giving up any compensation at all?
sentences.zh: 所以你是说你根本没有放弃任何报酬？

sentences.en: He said basically my pay is up to the board.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说我的薪水由董事会决定。

sentences.en: He noted that executives at the company weren't going to be getting a bonus this year.
sentences.zh: 他指出，公司高管今年不会获得奖金。

sentences.en: Again, our board will make those determinations.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我们的董事会将做出这些决定。

sentences.en: You're not accountable then.
sentences.zh: 那你就不负责任了。

sentences.en: You're saying the board's accountable.
sentences.zh: 你是说董事会负责。

sentences.en: Congressman, I am accountable, sir.
sentences.zh: 议员，我负责，先生。

sentences.en: I take responsibility for these two accidents that occurred on my watch.
sentences.zh: 我对在我任内发生的这两起事故负责。

sentences.en: I feel responsible to carry that through.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我有责任坚持到底。

sentences.en: As I mentioned earlier, I grew up on a farm in Iowa.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前提到的，我在爱荷华州的一个农场长大。

sentences.en: My dad taught me responsibility.
sentences.zh: 我父亲教导我责任感。

sentences.en: He said, you know, I'm an Iowa farm boy.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，我是一个爱荷华州的农场男孩。

sentences.en: I was taught by my dad that you work through these things.
sentences.zh: 我父亲教导我，你要克服这些事情。

sentences.en: What he told me is that when they're faced with challenges, to carry through.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我的是，当他们面临挑战时，要坚持下去。

sentences.en: And I don't want to run away from challenges.
sentences.zh: 我不想逃避挑战。

sentences.en: My intent is to see this through.
sentences.zh: 我的意图是坚持到底。

sentences.en: When asked if he was going to step down.
sentences.zh: 当被问及他是否会辞职时。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you, are you going to be stepping down as CEO of Boeing?
sentences.zh: 我想问你，你打算辞去波音公司CEO的职务吗？

sentences.en: He said directly.
sentences.zh: 他直接回答了。

sentences.en: Congresswoman, no.
sentences.zh: 女议员，不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: But the lawmakers really didn't let this issue of accountability go.
sentences.zh: 但立法者确实没有放过问责制这个问题。

sentences.en: At one point, one of the representatives said, Mr. Mullenberg, turn, face the families, look them in the eye.
sentences.zh: 有一次，其中一位代表说，穆伦伯格先生，转过身，面对家属，看着他们的眼睛。

sentences.en: I want you to take a look at them just for one second, because obviously you haven't spoken to them.
sentences.zh: 我想让你看他们一眼，就一秒钟，因为显然你还没有和他们说过话。

sentences.en: Congresswoman, no.
sentences.zh: 女议员，没有。

sentences.en: So I'm going to continue.
sentences.zh: 所以我将继续。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Mullenberg.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，穆伦伯格先生。

sentences.en: So, Natalie, how do these two days of hearings end?
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莉，这两天的听证会是如何结束的？

sentences.en: I thank the gentlelady.
sentences.zh: 我感谢这位女士。

sentences.en: I ask unanimous consent.
sentences.zh: 我请求一致同意。

sentences.en: So at the conclusion of all of this, as the final hearing is wrapping up, I step outside with Nadia Milleran, who's the mother of Samia Stumo, who died in the Ethiopia crash.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一切结束时，随着最后一场听证会的结束，我与在埃塞俄比亚坠机事故中丧生的萨米亚·斯图莫的母亲纳迪亚·米勒兰一起走到外面。

sentences.en: I just want to know, after two days of hearings, how do you feel now?
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道，经过两天的听证会，你现在感觉如何？

sentences.en: And I asked her, how have these hearings been for you?
sentences.zh: 我问她，这些听证会对你来说怎么样？

sentences.en: What do you make of this?
sentences.zh: 你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: And she says she's not satisfied.
sentences.zh: 她说她不满意。

sentences.en: In fact, I am horrified that he's getting a $15 million reward after these crashes.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我感到震惊的是，他在这些坠机事故后竟然还获得了1500万美元的奖励。

sentences.en: She's outraged by how much Mullenberg makes, and she can't believe these new revelations.
sentences.zh: 她对穆伦伯格赚了多少钱感到愤怒，她无法相信这些新的揭露。

sentences.en: The idea that there's new evidence that Boeing and that Mullenberg knew about employee concerns before the crashes.
sentences.zh: 有新的证据表明波音公司和穆伦伯格在坠机前就知道员工的担忧，这个想法（让她愤怒）。

sentences.en: It sounds like you feel like there have been new pieces of information that have come to life.
sentences.zh: 听起来你觉得有一些新的信息浮出水面了。

sentences.en: Definitely new pieces of information.
sentences.zh: 绝对是新的信息。

sentences.en: Those slides are definitely shocking to me that people waved their hand at Boeing and said things are wrong, and that he basically ignored them.
sentences.zh: 那些幻灯片对我来说绝对是令人震惊的，有人在波音公司挥手示意说事情不对劲，而他基本上无视了他们。

sentences.en: I mean, it just has her incensed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这让她非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And she says to me, you know, I actually need to go because I want to go confront him face-to-face when this thing ends.
sentences.zh: 她对我说，你知道，我真的得走了，因为我想在事情结束时去当面质问他。

sentences.en: So we go back inside.
sentences.zh: 所以我们回到里面。

sentences.en: DeFazio hits the gavel.
sentences.zh: 德法齐奥敲响了木槌。

sentences.en: The hearing's over.
sentences.zh: 听证会结束了。

sentences.en: Everybody's filing out.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在排队离开。

sentences.en: And Nadia marches over to Mullenberg and meets him face-to-face.
sentences.zh: 纳迪亚走向穆伦伯格并与他面对面。

sentences.en: And, you know, you could tell his people want to get him out of there.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你可以看出他的人想把他带离那里。

sentences.en: There's a security guard around.
sentences.zh: 周围有一个保安。

sentences.en: But he talks to her.
sentences.zh: 但他和她谈话了。

sentences.en: One of the things she says to him is,
sentences.zh: 她对他说的其中一件事是，

sentences.en: You know, you kept saying that you're an Iowa farm boy.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你一直说自己是个爱荷华州的农场男孩。

sentences.en: You know, and then you start talking about Iowa.
sentences.zh: 你知道，然后你就开始谈论爱荷华州。

sentences.en: And you talked about Iowa just like one too many times.
sentences.zh: 你谈论爱荷华州的次数实在太多了。

sentences.en: And the whole group said, go back to the farm.
sentences.zh: 整个团队都说，回农场去吧。

sentences.en: Go back to Iowa.
sentences.zh: 回爱荷华州去吧。

sentences.en: Do that.
sentences.zh: 就这么做吧。

sentences.en: Well, we, the family members of the victims, want you to go back to the farm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们，受害者的家属，希望你回农场去。

sentences.en: And it's because when you make all mistakes like that and you can acknowledge them, then, you know, maybe someone else should do that work.
sentences.zh: 这是因为当你犯下所有这些错误，并且能够承认它们时，你知道，也许应该由别人来做这项工作。

sentences.en: She's saying, we don't think you're the guy that should be in here trying to solve this.
sentences.zh: 她的意思是，我们认为你不应该是那个在这里试图解决这个问题的人。

sentences.en: We don't trust you.
sentences.zh: 我们不信任你。

sentences.en: That's what she's saying.
sentences.zh: 这就是她想表达的。

sentences.en: She's saying, we don't want you in there.
sentences.zh: 她的意思是，我们不想让你待在那里。

sentences.en: And he says, I respect your inputs there.
sentences.zh: 他说，我尊重你们的意见。

sentences.en: And I'll just tell you, we are very focused on safety.
sentences.zh: 我只想告诉你们，我们非常关注安全问题。

sentences.en: And you have my commitment, my personal commitment and the commitment of our company that we're going to make the safety improvements we need to make.
sentences.zh: 你们有我的承诺，我个人的承诺，以及我们公司的承诺，我们将进行必要的安全改进。

sentences.en: And so at the end of this, they're at this kind of impasse where she's saying, we want you out.
sentences.zh: 所以最后，他们陷入了一种僵局，她说，我们想让你离开。

sentences.en: And he says, I hear you, but I'm not going anywhere.
sentences.zh: 他说，我听到了，但我哪儿也不会去。

sentences.en: Transparency.
sentences.zh: 透明度。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Transparency.
sentences.zh: 透明度。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: At that point, they turn and walk away from each other.
sentences.zh: 就在那一刻，他们转身走开了。

sentences.en: She walks over to the group of families and he walks out of the hearing.
sentences.zh: 她走向家属团队，而他走出了听证会。

sentences.en: That all sounds kind of unsatisfying to everybody.
sentences.zh: 这对所有人来说听起来都有些令人不满。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I don't think anybody walked out feeling particularly good about what happened in that room.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有谁在走出那个房间时对发生的事情感到特别满意。

sentences.en: Natalie, thank you.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: The Boeing 737 MAX remains grounded.
sentences.zh: 波音737 MAX机型仍然处于停飞状态。

sentences.en: The company's board of directors is standing by Dennis Smullenberg.
sentences.zh: 公司董事会支持丹尼斯·米伦伯格。

sentences.en: And Congress says its investigation will continue.
sentences.zh: 国会表示调查将继续进行。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: In the latest testimony before impeachment investigators, a Foreign Service officer assigned to the White House, Catherine Croft,
sentences.zh: 在弹劾调查人员面前的最新证词中，一位被派往白宫的外交官凯瑟琳·克罗夫特，

sentences.en: offered new insight into the campaign to fire the U.S.
sentences.zh: 提供了关于解雇美国驻乌克兰大使玛丽·约万诺维奇运动的新见解。

sentences.en: ambassador to Ukraine, Marie Yovanovitch.
sentences.zh: 大使玛丽·约万诺维奇。

sentences.en: The officer testified that a well-known former Republican congressman, Robert Livingston, now a lobbyist,
sentences.zh: 这位官员作证说，一位知名的前共和党国会议员，现为说客的罗伯特·利文斯顿，

sentences.en: repeatedly told her that Yovanovitch needed to be removed because she was an ally of President Obama with a liberal agenda.
sentences.zh: 多次告诉她，约万诺维奇必须被免职，因为她是奥巴马总统的盟友，有着自由派议程。

sentences.en: The same dubious claims made by President Trump and his lawyer, Rudy Giuliani.
sentences.zh: 这与特朗普总统及其律师鲁迪·朱利安尼所提出的怀疑论调如出一辙。

sentences.en: Both Trump and Giuliani viewed Yovanovitch as an obstacle in their attempts to pressure Ukraine to investigate Trump's rivals.
sentences.zh: 特朗普和朱利安尼都将约万诺维奇视为他们试图向乌克兰施压以调查特朗普竞争对手时的障碍。

sentences.en: And, well, right now the fire is encircling the Air Force One pavilion where obviously the famous Air Force One sits.
sentences.zh: 而且，嗯，现在大火正在包围空军一号展馆，显然著名的空军一号就停在那里。

sentences.en: It's a national treasure.
sentences.zh: 那是国宝。

sentences.en: The latest California wildfire in Ventura County burned its way to within 100 yards of the Ronald Reagan Presidential Library, whose executive director,
sentences.zh: 加州文图拉县最新的野火烧到了距离罗纳德·里根总统图书馆不到100码的地方，该图书馆的执行主任，

sentences.en: in an interview with CBS News, said that the flames had encircled the pavilion holding Reagan's private plane.
sentences.zh: 在接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻采访时说，火焰已经包围了存放里根私人飞机的展馆。

sentences.en: So far, the library's been protected, but we're surrounded on all sides by the fire right now.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，图书馆得到了保护，但我们现在四面都被火包围了。

sentences.en: Like many of the fires that have erupted in recent dates, the Ventura County blaze was fueled by dry conditions and wind gusts that have reached hurricane force.
sentences.zh: 像最近爆发的许多火灾一样，文图拉县的大火是由干燥的环境和达到飓风强度的阵风助燃的。

sentences.en: In western Los Angeles, a different fire briefly threatened the Getty Center, a museum filled with priceless artworks, before firefighters beat back the flames.
sentences.zh: 在洛杉矶西部，另一场火灾曾短暂威胁到盖蒂中心，那是一个收藏了无数无价艺术品的博物馆，随后消防员扑灭了火焰。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的内容。
